lines: Built with: vite.config.ts, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^2.3.5 (locked 2.5.4).
@nextcloud/vue ^9.0.0-rc.2 declared.
Written against: mapbox-gl 2.4.1, 2 delivered packages; vue 3.5.41, 16 delivered packages; leaflet 1.9.4, 5 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 41, maplibre-gl 6.4.0, moment 2.30.1, focus-trap 8.2.2, jquery 4.0.0, kjua 0.10.0, node-gettext 3.0.1, and 35 more.
Packages and versions are those the .license files beside the chunks name, since the source maps miss packages through the toolchain defect named here.

Known toolchain defect: vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 4.0.1 in package-lock.json, where the CSS is injected by JavaScript, puts the code that injects the CSS in front of the chunk without shifting its source map, so the map the bundler combines from it loses sources. Here the map of AdminSettings-DprXGo8Q.chunk.mjs names 0 of the 2 packages its .license file names, and 13 further chunks show the same.
The app runs as built; only the map is short, so the frameworks and libraries are read from the .license files instead.
Fixed in vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 5.0.0: https://github.com/marco-prontera/vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js/issues/155
